summary: Bumble Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 12, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger among the Company, Buzz Holdings L.P., Ithaca Holdco, Inc., and two merger subsidiaries. A special committee of independent directors unanimously approved the transaction, which will take Bumble private via a two-step corporate and Opco merger. Each Class A share converts into $6.05 cash, while Class B shares convert into $0.000001 cash. The structure preserves the existing dual-class ownership split via rollover units. What to watch: shareholder approval, regulatory clearance, and any competing superior proposals.
